🚇 A typical weekday on the Tokyo subway.

All 13 lines of Tokyo Metro and Toei, threading under the city around the Imperial Palace. Stations and tracks are real; the service is reconstructed from typical frequencies (trains every few minutes, every 2–3 at rush hour), not the official timetable.
